title: Human--AI Interactions as First-Class Data: A Formal Interaction Model and Runtime for Explainable AI Collaboration
abstract: arXiv:2610.40006v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI assistants are increasingly embedded in computational notebooks, scientific workflows, software engineering tools, and learning systems, yet human-AI interactions are often treated as transient prompt-response exchanges rather than durable data products, hindering reproducibility, explainability, replay, behavioral analysis, and adaptive AI support. We argue that these interactions form a new data class requiring formal representation and introduce the Human-AI Interaction Description Language (HAIDL), a formal interaction model with a Backus-Naur Form-inspired concrete syntax. HAIDL encodes each interaction as a structured object capturing computational context, user request, prompt payload, AI response, feedback, problem context, provenance, and model metadata. translated_title: 人机交互作为一等数据：一种面向可解释AI协作的形式化交互模型与运行时
translated_abstract: AI助手日益嵌入到计算笔记本、科学工作流、软件工程工具和学习系统中，然而人机交互通常被视为瞬时的提示-响应交换，而非持久的数据产品，这阻碍了可复现性、可解释性、重放、行为分析和自适应AI支持。我们主张这些交互构成了一个需要形式化表示的新数据类别，并介绍了人机交互描述语言（HAIDL），这是一种采用受巴科斯-诺尔范式启发的具体语法的正式交互模型。HAIDL将每次交互编码为结构化对象，捕获计算上下文、用户请求、提示载荷、AI响应、反馈、问题上下文、来源信息和模型元数据。我们将这一愿景集成到HAIDL-X中，这是一个用于JupyterLab的中间件，通过捕获用户与机器人的状态、构建上下文化提示、与AI提供方交互等方式来实例化HAIDL。
tldr: 本文提出将人机AI交互视为“一等公民”数据的新范式，设计了形式化交互描述语言HAIDL及其JupyterLab运行时中间件HAIDL-X，以支持可复现、可解释和可重放的AI协作。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes treating human-AI interactions as first-class data by introducing HAIDL, a formal interaction description language, together with HAIDL-X, a JupyterLab middleware runtime enabling reproducible, explainable, and replayable AI collaboration.
